name: Eurocircuits
notes: Values from the eC classification table (dated 07/05/2024) and the PCB design guideline pages. Eurocircuits measures annular rings, hole spacing and IPI from the production TOOLSIZE (PTH ENDSIZE + 0.10 mm); values here are converted to KiCad's finished-hole convention and the conversion is noted. Pattern classes 3-6 are available in all services (PCB proto included); class 7 in STANDARD/DZ/RF/SEMI-FLEX; classes 8-9 in STANDARD/DZ/RF only. STANDARD pool: "100um Track & Gap pooling - 90 um Non-pooling", so class 9 leaves pooling. Drill class C is available in PCB proto and STANDARD; D (0.15) and E (0.10) only in STANDARD/DZ/RF/SF. Pooled classes above 6 are not in PCB proto and may change the price; the guideline pages do not quantify it.

profiles.label: Class 6C (0.150 mm), 1-2 layer, PCB proto / STANDARD pool

value_notes.track_width: Pattern class 6: OTW and OTT-OTP-OPP = 0.150 mm.
value_notes.via_drill: Drill class C: min PTH finished hole (ENDSIZE) 0.25 mm; production TOOLSIZE = ENDSIZE + 0.10 = 0.35 mm. Drill classes D (0.15) and E (0.10) also exist in STANDARD pool.
value_notes.via_diameter: Eurocircuits measures rings from the TOOLSIZE: pad = 0.35 + 2 x 0.125 (OAR).
value_notes.via_annular_ring: Ring relative to the finished hole = (pad - 0.25)/2 (kept consistent with via_diameter). Published ring is OAR 0.125 mm measured from the 0.35 mm TOOLSIZE.
value_notes.pth_annular_ring: Same as via (class OAR/IAR apply to all plated holes). NPTH with copper pads: 0.30 mm ring recommended.
value_notes.npth_drill: Drill class C: NPTH min 0.35 mm (TOOLSIZE = ENDSIZE for NPTH).
value_notes.max_drill: Not published in the design guidelines.
value_notes.hole_to_hole: "The minimum drill hole to drill hole distance is 0.25mm (10mil), measured edge to edge of the drill TOOLSIZE" -> 0.35 mm between finished PTH holes (each tool is 0.05 mm larger in radius).
value_notes.edge_clearance: "Routed boards: 0.25mm (10mil) on outer layers, 0.40mm (16mil) on inner layers"; scored (V-cut): 0.45mm.
value_notes.silk_to_pad: Legend to exposed copper 0.100 mm (to holes 0.100, to routed edge 0.250).
value_notes.mask_bridge: LDI mask (green/black/red/blue) MSM 0.075 mm; white/transparent PI mask 0.130 mm. Needs pad-to-pad >= 0.135 mm (LDI) to keep a web.
value_notes.mask_expansion: LDI MAR 0.030 mm (PI white/transparent 0.100 mm). Min mask opening 0.40 mm. Vias are never tented unless via filling is ordered.
value_notes.plated_slot_width: "The smallest slot width is 0.50mm finished size (ENDSIZE)"
value_notes.castellated_hole: Plated holes on the board edge are offered (not in PCB proto) but no minimum size is given on the guideline pages.
value_notes.smd_pad_to_pad: OPP of the pattern class; >= 0.135 mm needed for an LDI mask web between pads.
value_notes.outer_copper_oz: 35 um finished outer copper (18 um base foil + plating).
value_notes.hole_to_copper: Only IPI (inner layers) is published; no outer-layer hole-to-copper rule.
